items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Loxie is coming up. I wonder if he can get him, we can get him.

ctx.x: Back in those days, I was still living. You know how they talk about cows that had TB and all that stuff. See sons have ruined a lot of things. Now you take me. I never, I didn't, see I was a bottom baby because I was very sick. My mother was sick when I was born. See. That's why I don't have cremable meat, wheat today. And they had to have a special car for me to get that milk from me. Oh yeah? Yeah, a special car. Oh excuse. See that, that's one thing the doctors know back then. The special car, one car milk…
Wait what? Please come on up. It says 305 or 307. Alright. Loxie is coming up. I wonder if he can get him, we can get him. Yeah, when he comes up we'll get himself.

Yeah so, yeah there was some, there was some beautiful days back in them days. Beautiful women, man. Oh. Yeah? And then there's Ray La Dixie. You had anything you want. And for years no band, you couldn't get a band out of New Orleans because it was too great.
